The line about preserving evidence to avoid liability also reads as advice on dodging accountability, so I need to address that too.

I'm checking the figures in the draft next, and they don't hold up: the "90%" falsification rate, the SEC 70% number, the cited paper, and the 8-12% drop all look invented. The 130% margin call rule is also being applied to mortgage loans, which is wrong. The draft further contradicts itself, claiming no one can predict outcomes while giving near-certain hypotheticals, and it says both to give up and to participate if you insist.
